personal.preferred_title: C++ Backend Engineer | Multithreading, Linux/Windows, High-Throughput Systems & Financial Technology

summary: Senior enterprise engineer with 20+ years of experience across C, C++, object-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, Unix/Linux, Windows concepts, SQL/RDBMS integration, performance tuning, production troubleshooting, and financial-services technology. Strong background building and supporting mission-critical backend systems, telecom billing interfaces, high-throughput transaction platforms, migration utilities, and production support workflows. Best aligned to C++ backend roles requiring OO programming, templates/design-pattern thinking, multithreaded systems, high-throughput optimization, Windows/Linux support, QA/support collaboration, and ownership of production-facing issues; recent work has focused more on Python/SQL/data reliability, while C++/Pro*C systems work is substantial but earlier-career.

Created runbooks, metric definitions, data flow notes, support procedures, troubleshooting notes, and operational documentation to improve repeatability and handoff.
Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, engineering, and business teams to prioritize issues, explain findings, coordinate fixes, and improve operational reliability.

experience.title: Performance Engineer

Investigated performance and reliability issues by correlating monitoring data, transaction behavior, and load-test results.
Documented findings, risks, and recommendations for application and infrastructure teams supporting production-facing systems.

Provided production support, defect investigation, data maintenance, issue escalation, troubleshooting, deployment support, and QA-cycle coordination for telecom billing and customer-management applications.
